item.title: Millions of hacking attempts as companies, governments rush to patch PHP flaws

High Court Judge Andrew Chan Hing-wai on Thursday noted from the assessment reports that Fan Chi-yuen, 22, had shown no remorse or empathy towards his victims. item.title: Missing lift fire door frames confined to Taizoom, Hong Kong authorities say
item.description: Inspections into lift safety across Hong Kong have found no missing fire-resistant door frames among contractors other than Taizoom Elevator, authorities said on Thursday, after 338 buildings served by the firm were confirmed to lack the crucial components. item.title: Rahul Gandhi's nephew says he was forced to remove protest artwork from Delhi exhibition
